environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in a hardened account. The execution environment uses a custom Lambda Extension that loads an AppArmor profile (lambda-proxy-restrict) at init phase via /opt/extensions/apparmor-loader. The profile denies network connect() to any address except 127.0.0.1 and the specific backend IP 10.0.3.47 on port 8080. Additionally, the API Gateway is REST API (v1) with a request validator resource policy that enforces a JSON Schema on the request body and uses a Gateway Response mapping that strips Transfer-Encoding headers via VTL template ($input.params().header.remove('Transfer-Encoding')). The Lambda also has a resource-based policy condition restricting invocation source to the specific API Gateway ARN. The AppArmor profile additionally restricts file write to /tmp/response-cache/** only (deny /tmp/** w outside that subtree, deny /** w globally except /tmp/response-cache/**).

config.api_gateway: REST API v1 with request validator and GatewayResponse VTL mapping
config.backend: nginx/1.21 with proxy_pass to upstream app
config.apparmor_profile: lambda-proxy-restrict (loaded via Lambda Extension at init)
config.api_gw_vtl_strip: Transfer-Encoding header removed in request mapping template
config.api_gw_schema_validation: body must conform to JSON schema (rejects chunked/malformed bodies)
